notes.title: Update on December 7
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for your comments and suggestions on paper bride. We have optimized and repaired it in response according to the feedbacks. The specific content is as follows:

1. Added a switch button for full screen and window mode in the setting interface
2. Added the function to close the window by pressing "ESC"

If you meet any problems during the game, please feel free to contact us .
Facebook: @gamefpscom
Twitter: @gamefpscom
